COMPOSITION:
- Chairperson (appointed by Central Government)
- 10 Members:
  * 5 full-time members
  * 4 part-time members (Government nominees)

2. DEVELOPMENTAL FUNCTIONS:
✓ Promote growth of insurance industry
✓ Encourage insurance penetration
✓ Protect policyholders' interests
✓ Establish grievance redressal machinery
✓ Promote professional organizations

3. MONITORING FUNCTIONS:
